## Espectros de Diseño {#sec-mcer_results}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/MCER.ES.qmd",
    stem = "structures-criteria",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "tabla de criterios de estructuras"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/MCE.MDE.ES.qmd",
    stem = "structures-mcer",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "figura de criterios de estructuras"
  )
}
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "i", "SiteTable"
), ls()))
```
